discarded_claims.claim: The driver cannot repair the shortfall by accumulating separate in-geofence intervals. There is only one such interval on this trace (run_count 1, longest run 195 seconds), and POL-NS-06 limb (i) in any event requires a traffic advisory that is present and populated with a type of KERB_RESTRICTION, ENFORCEMENT, CLOSURE or ACCIDENT. EV-ADVIS-00203-01 is MISSING — its weight is 0.0 and the absence is itself citable — so no advisory covers this pickup road in this window, limb (i) is unavailable, and the 195-second measurement stands as the effective dwell.
discarded_claims.reason: The claim cites EV-ADVIS-00203-01, whose weight_multiplier is 0.0, but it does not name the issue code MISSING_ARTIFACT; it says only that the artifact is MISSING. POL-GEN-02(1) requires the impaired artifact's issue codes to be disclosed.

ruling.explanation: For the rider: the $4.00 no-show cancellation fee is refunded in full. The driver did genuinely arrive at the pickup pin, but the waiting period was not met. The GPS trace measures one continuous in-geofence hold of 195 seconds from 19:41:20 to 19:44:35. The STANDARD minimum is 300 seconds, so there was a 105-second shortfall, and the driver cancelled at 19:44:40, before the required wait had matured. POL-NS-01 limb (c) therefore fails, and POL-NS-06 requires the cancellation-fee line to be refunded in full. For the driver: the record shows a real arrival at the pin, with a closest approach of 18.7 m, stationary holding, and no POL-NS-05 false-arrival trigger, so no false-arrival referral is made. No driver compensation is payable because POL-NS-01 is not satisfied in full and POL-NS-06 displaces POL-NS-07. No accumulation under POL-NS-06(i) is available: there was only one in-geofence interval, and the traffic advisory is MISSING at weight 0.0 with issue MISSING_ARTIFACT, so it cannot support summing. The fare breakdown's $4.00 cancellation fee reconciles with the STANDARD/RYDE_X schedule. The chat log is impaired at weight 0.85 for LANGUAGE_AMBIGUITY; I have not relied on it for the refund, which rests on the unimpaired GPS trace and trip record at weight 1.0. No POL-NS-09 escalation trigger applies: confidence is above 0.70, no admissible artifacts contradict each other on arrival, dwell or rider presence, no same-pair dispute pattern is shown, the anti-farming check does not trip, and the deciding fact is not carried solely by an impaired artifact. The fee is refunded.
